_note: Deployment orders (Logan, 2026-09-29): the Operator offers three after Launch, one of each kind, shuffled, and the kind is never shown. boost = a plain boost; tradeoff = run-defining, with a cost; gamble = anything random. {name} in the text is filled from balance.json orders.<id>. Text is Claude's draft for Logan to vet.

orders.name: Supply Drop
orders.text: +{scraps} scraps.

orders.name: Requisition
orders.text: Choose a category, then take 1 of 3 Salvaged parts from it.

orders.name: Extra Frame Square
orders.text: Add a frame square wherever you want.

orders.name: Expanded Cargo
orders.text: Cargo gets +{rows} row.

orders.name: Field Repair Kit
orders.text: Repair bays restore 50% more HP this mission.

orders.name: Cold Start
orders.text: Your hardpoints start your first {fights} fights with Coolant {stacks}.

orders.name: Wider Picks
orders.text: Salvage offers {options} parts instead of 3 after your first {fights} fights.

orders.name: Friendly Merchant
orders.text: One part is free at your first autonomous bay.

orders.name: Stripped Frame
orders.text: +{scraps} scraps. Choose one of your components to strip out; it's gone for the mission.

orders.name: Modular Chassis
orders.text: Add {cells} frame squares wherever you want. The components you launch with have 10 less max HP.

orders.name: Overclocked Core
orders.text: +{max_heat} max heat. Venting drops from 80% to 60% at max heat.

orders.name: Hot Start
orders.text: +{max_heat} max heat. Every fight starts with {start_heat} heat.

orders.name: Salvage Rights
orders.text: Fights pay 50% more scraps. There are no repair bays on this route.

orders.name: Hunter's Route
orders.text: Elites roll rarity {elite_rolls} times and keep the best. Elites show up twice as often, from the second row on.

orders.name: Loan Shark
orders.text: +{scraps} scraps now. Your first {unpaid_fights} fights pay no scraps.

orders.name: Blind Drop
orders.text: +{scraps} scraps and take 1 of 3 Prototype parts. You only see {sight_rows} rows ahead on the map.

orders.name: Hot Insertion
orders.text: Take 1 of 3 Salvaged parts, twice. Your first {strong_fights} fights are the tough ones.

orders.name: Heavy Hauler
orders.text: Cargo gets +{rows} rows and +{cols} column. 1 less max heat.

orders.name: Spare Parts Crate
orders.text: {parts} random Surplus parts, stowed in Cargo.

orders.name: Prototype Contract
orders.text: A random Prototype part. Your installed components start at 60% HP.

orders.name: Scramble
orders.text: Every installed component is swapped for a random one of the same type, one rarity higher. You refit before you drop.

orders.name: Transmute
orders.text: Choose one installed component. It becomes a random one of the same type, one rarity higher. You refit before you drop.

orders.name: Heat Sinks
orders.text: +{max_heat} max heat.

orders.name: Wide Cargo
orders.text: Cargo gets +{cols} column.

orders.name: Black Market
orders.text: {free_parts} parts are free at your first autonomous bay. Fights pay 25% fewer scraps.

orders.name: Heavy Plating
orders.text: The components you launch with get +{part_hp} max HP. Venting drops from 80% to 70% at max heat.

orders.name: Forced March
orders.text: +{scraps} scraps. Half as many repair bays on this route.

orders.name: Special Requisition
orders.text: Choose a category, then take 1 of 3 Prototype parts from it. Every fight starts with {start_heat} heat.

orders.name: Mystery Crate
orders.text: {parts} random parts of any type and rarity, stowed in Cargo.

orders.name: Coin Flip
orders.text: Heads: +{scraps} scraps. Tails: your components start at 70% HP.

orders.name: Unmapped Route
orders.text: Nobody has charted this route: repair bays, autonomous bays, events and elites each show up anywhere from half as often to twice as often.
